name: Time's Disillusion
source:
It's been two years since a friend was lost. Despite everything, the final race ended in tension, a crash, and no hope of contact. Today, there's no time for those things at the restaurant; not in this downturn. That dream was over. Or so he thought.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2288100/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
自从失去一位朋友以来已经两年了。尽管如此，最后一场比赛还是在紧张、撞车和没有接触的希望中结束了。今天，没有时间去餐厅做这些事情；不是在这次经济低迷时期。那个梦结束了。或者说他是这么想的。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2288100/]Steam[/url]]
